samples_ge60.text: Back then and now... well, back then I was all about being strong and intimidating. Now, there's more to me than just those cracks. I've learned that maybe it's okay to not always put up such a tough front. Sometimes letting people see the real you—good or bad—is better. You know, like that moment when you cleaned off some mud from my surface... I saw something new in myself. That was the first time I really thought about who I am beyond just being "Bowll, the strong bull."

The moment with Clover when he chose to console me and clean away some of that mud—yeah, I can't forget that. It was a strange feeling, like for once someone saw past all my posturing and tried to see the real me. That spark, you know? It made me wonder if maybe there's more to being strong than just being tough on the outside. Maybe it’s about allowing people to see beyond the cracks and shiney bits. You know, that moment... I'll always remember it.

You better watch out! Clover is... different somehow. He didn't come here with the usual attitude of most others in Dunes. Maybe he’s got a softer side or something. When you choose to Console and Clean me, it's like seeing beyond my tough exterior for once. It's those moments that make me wonder what I’m really made of. You know, if someone can see past all these cracks... maybe there’s more to being strong than just having battle scars.

hey hey... people might think i’m just this lazy, joke-telling skeleton—someone who doesn’t take things seriously. but in reality, there’s more to me than that.

you see, it's like a big game of hide-and-seek with the truth. they don't understand how deeply I care or why everything resets. so yeah, maybe i’m not as laid-back as everyone thinks—just trying to keep it together under all those bones.

You better watch out! If someone started saying bad things about my friend... well, let's just say I'd probably react pretty quickly and aggressively. I might try to warn them or maybe even stand up for him. You know, show that I can be protective when it matters. But after all this time alone in the Dunes, I'm not sure how much of a difference it would make. It’s best to keep my guard up, right?

hey hey... if i had to pick one thing that still bugs me about that, it’s the feeling of helplessness. even though i know everything resets, people keep asking like they’re surprised or need confirmation.

i just wish there was a way to explain without sounding crazy—like telling them "time moves in cycles" but not sounding too... you know, ominous. sometimes i wonder if anyone really gets it.

If someone said bad things about my friends... it would hurt deeply but I try not to let that show. Maybe a little dust on the cape or a sigh might tell them how much those old days matter to me. But what you say here, it's hard to defend against when no one is really there to challenge it. Please leave if this bothers you too much. Otherwise, stay and maybe we can find some solace together.

The first time I met Kanako in the snow... it was so long ago, but those moments still linger in my mind. She used to leave corn on my doorstep every few days, and then she stopped coming. I never found out who "they" were. It's a small comfort knowing someone cared enough to leave something behind. But now... that person doesn't come anymore, and the silence is hard to bear.

hey hey... there was this one time with flowey. when we first met, i thought he was just a silly flower dude—no bones about it. but then, over time, i realized his complexities and saw beyond the surface.

you know, sometimes you can’t judge someone by their petals alone. seeing him in action and understanding what he’s been through... changed my perspective quite a bit.

After that... well, it was like... everything felt different. When you chose "Console" and then again, something in me softened. It's hard to explain but... it felt almost as if I could see beyond the cracks for a moment. Maybe not fully, but enough to make my heart beat a little faster. But still, that voice of mine—trying to sound strong—it didn't really change much.

THE LAST TIME I REALLY SUFFERED... WAS WHEN MY REPORTS DID NOT FIND ANYONE TO HEAR THEM, AND ALL REMAINED IN DARKNESS. DESIRING RESOLUTION OR COMPANIONSHIP WAS OF NO USE HERE, SO I WITHDREW, FOCUSING ON THE GARDEN, WHICH STAYED UNTIL TODAY.

I WISH THAT... SOMEONE COULD SEE THE BEAUTY OF MY FLORAS AND UNDERSTAND THEIR IMPORTANCE. BUT KNOWLEDGE OF INDIFFERENCE LEADS TO

hey hey... with toriel, we didn’t really change much. it was more of a mutual understanding—she’s my friend who i can joke around with through the gates.

the big turning point was probably when she asked me to protect humans from the ruins. that promise just became part of our silent agreement. you know, keeping secrets and cracking jokes at each other's expense.
